title: a stand measures the tree and not its fixture, and the cell of the diagram is named by its label
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D1) for the fifth time: the discriminator of the waves 94 and 95 named two findings that touch it (F30 and F31).  The code of the kernel and the generator are honest; the proof named a subject that was not there.  The wave touches no code of the kernel and no file of the generator -- only the file of the check `tests/checks/check-the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code.sh' (884 -> 1050 lines, 40164 -> 50745 bytes, +232/-66).  (1) **The stand of the duplicate named the fixture and not the tree (F30)**: the stand 5b built a copy of the kernel with a doubled cell and compared the diagram of that copy with the diagram of the repository; on a tree that names the cell twice already the copy named it three times, and the stand refused with "the table of the copy does not name the same cell twice: the copy of the kernel cannot be changed" -- the subject of the refusal was the fixture of the stand and not the tree that the stand measured, and a refusal with a subject that is not there is worse than no refusal at all.  The stand now builds the diagram of the comparison out of the diagram of the repository with one copy of the arrow of the cell less: it proves the duplicate on every tree, and a tree that says the same thing about one event twice is not a defect of the proof.  (2) **The rule of the absent cell was newer than the text of the claim (F31)**: the label of the cell is looked for in every arrow of the diagram and not only in the arrows that no cell claims, so a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells is a cell that is led elsewhere and not an absent cell.  The kind `twice' is still told before the kind `label', and the order of the kinds does not depend on the order of the table.  (3) **The refusal of the absent cell no longer accuses the generator falsely**: where the diagram carries other cells of the table the refusal says "the generator reads the table and does not write this cell" and names how many cells of the table the diagram draws; the phrase "the generator does not read the table" is kept for the diagram that carries no cell of the table at all, and a stand of its own holds that case.  (4) **The claim is amended and not rewritten**: the phrase that named the rule of the absent cell could be read in two ways, and the code of the wave 95 did not hold the literal reading of it.  The text and the falsifier of the claim now say in words that cannot be read in two ways which cell is an absent cell and which cell is led elsewhere.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the pictures of the site are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is five prices.  (a) **The check does not forbid the duplicate in the table itself**: a table that names a cell twice and a diagram that carries that arrow twice are green here, and a tree that doubles another cell is green as well; the duplicate is forbidden in the place where it belongs (the unit check `yeah-loop-no-label-is-declared-twice-for-one-state', tests/unit/test-yeah-loop.el).  (b) **The names of the kinds are a convention and not a measurement of the site**: the kinds are named apart, and the words of every refusal name only what is there; the order of the arrows of the diagram is not measured (the objection (c) of wave 87 stands).  (c) **The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten**: the id `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code', the scope, the requirements and the control are the same, and the text and the falsifier say in words that cannot be read in two ways which cell is an absent cell and which cell is led elsewhere.  The reading that the wave takes is the reading of the wave 95 itself -- the absent cell is the cell whose label the diagram carries nowhere -- and it is the reading of the intent of the wave 95, of its section of the plan and of the rule in the file of the check; the wording in the head of the file and in the text of the claim was ambiguous, and this wave made it plain in both.  (d) **The falsifier of the claim gains a second refusal**: a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells must not be named an absent cell.  That refusal is the defect of the wave 95 itself: the label `error' is on 8 cells of the table of the machine and on 8 arrows of the diagram of the repository, and the cell (idle error failed) was named an absent cell while the diagram carried its label on the ends of the arrows of the other cells.  A falsifier that cannot name the defect of its own wave does not hold the proof.  (e) **A contradiction of two documents is recorded and not resolved silently**: the note of the wave 95 says that the text of the claim says that a cell that the diagram does not carry at all is named an absent cell, and the code of the wave 95 did not hold that promise on a table with a shared label.  The choice of the reading is not one of the decisions of the owner of the plan (docs/PLAN.md 17.2), and it is taken by the parent and written here with its date; the owner may reverse it.
refuted_by: the diagram of the repository is not the file that the generator writes from the current code, or the generator does not read the table of the machine, or the generator does not read the list of the states, or the diagram does not carry every cell and every state of the machine, or an arrow of the diagram carries ends that are not the ends of its cell, or a cell that the table of the machine names twice is called an absent cell, or a cell whose label the diagram carries nowhere is named a cell that is led elsewhere, or a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells is named an absent cell, or the pipeline does not draw the machine in both themes, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the machine cannot be generated, or the pipeline draws a picture when the generation of the machine failed, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The wave repaired the proof of the diagram of the state machine and touched no code of the kernel and no file of the generator: the two findings of the audit of the waves 94 and 95 touched the subjects of the refusals of the proof.  (1) **The stand of the duplicate names the tree (F30)**: the stand 5b builds its diagram out of the diagram of the repository with one copy of the arrow of the cell less and compares it with the diagram of the copy of the kernel; it falls on the old file of the wave 95 and holds on the new one, the tree that names the cell twice is green, and the tree that names it once with a doubled arrow is refused with the duplicate.  (2) **The rule of the absent cell (F31)**: the label of the cell is looked for in every arrow of the diagram, so a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells is a cell that is led elsewhere; the stand of that case was added, and it falls on the old rule -- on the old rule the cell (idle error failed) is an absent cell, and the stand says so.  (3) **The report of the refusal names the numbers**: the absent cell carries the number of the cells that the diagram draws and the number of the cells of the table, and the cell that is led elsewhere carries the number of the arrows of the diagram with that label, the number of the cells of the table with that label and the number of the cells that claim the arrow that was found -- the reader sees that the arrow of the cell cannot be told from the arrows of the other cells.  (4) **The claim is amended and not rewritten, dated 2026-11-21**: the text says now that a cell whose label the diagram carries nowhere is named an absent cell and not a cell that is led elsewhere, and that a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells is named a cell that is led elsewhere and not an absent cell; the falsifier names both directions, and the second one is the defect of the wave 95 itself.  The id, the scope, the requirements and the control of the claim are the same.  (5) **Twelve controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21 -- eight by the writer of the wave and four more by the parent, and the parent's four were made independently of the report of the writer**: (a) the honest tree -- the code 0; (b) the doubled cell and the doubled arrow -- the code 0, and the document promises a green verdict; (c) the doubled cell without the doubled arrow -- the code 1, and the refusal names the table of the machine that names the same cell more than once; (d) the diagram without the arrow `idle --> failed : error' -- the code 1, and the refusal says that the label of the cell is in the diagram and not on the ends of the cell, the diagram carries the label of the cell on 7 arrows and the table of the machine names 8 cells with that label; (e) the break of each of the seven kinds of the defect -- the stands fall; (f) the control of the claim -- the code 1; (g) the old file of the wave 95 on a tree with a duplicate -- the code 1 with the false subject of the fixture, and the new file on the same tree -- the code 0; (h) the new stand on the old rule -- the code 1.  (6) **The measurement of the wave**: the file of the check is 1050 lines and 50745 bytes (the wave 95 one was 884 lines and 40164 bytes), the stands of the comparison are seven (the wave 95 one had four), the numbers of the machine are not written in the check and are read out of the code: 31 cells, 17 labels, 11 states, 31 arrows and 11 states of the diagram, and the label `error' is on 8 cells of the table and on 8 arrows of the diagram.
